implementation: Socionext Secure Module Crypto Engine (External GCM IV)
description: The Socionext Secure Module Crypto Engine provides the cryptographic functions. It supports cryptographic algorithms below: AES, Triple DES, SHA-1, SHA-2, MAC generation, Digital Signature generation/verification, ECDH Primitive computation, Key Derivation and Deterministic Random Number Generation.
